messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: KV-cache continuous-batching spike in prod-eu-west-1. Error rate 12% over last 5m, 99p latency 8.4s, 5m token throughput down 40%. Autopager: severity=sev2
Ana (oncall): Got it, I'm on. Noted perf cliff around 13:04 UTC. Pulling traces and logs
Kevin SRE: seeing same. Batcher queue depth growing on nodes k8s-prod-eu-*; long requests dominating. suspect fairness starvation between short chat/rtoken vs long-completion jobs
Li (runtime): logs show repeated KV cache reclamation and \"kv_get_timeout\" spikes. Also a burst of >50MB KVCACHE eviction events/sec. Likely cache-blowup from a new model rollout earlier today.
Ana (oncall): timeline: 12:30 deploy of model v2-small -> increased long prompts. 12:58 slight increase, 13:02 spike. Rolling back model isn't safe for latency-sensitive customers on Dedicated. Need live mitigation.
Maria PM: any customer-facing impact yet? CS onstand?
Raj CS: two enterprise tenants reported timeouts on the completions endpoint between 13:05-13:12. Some 504s from gateway, client-side SLA breaches. Currently collecting request IDs.
Kevin SRE: immediate mitigation idea: throttle continuous-batching by lowering batch_size and enabling strict fairness so short requests get served first. Also tune kv_cache eviction throttle.
Li (runtime): Agreed. We have a runtime flag: --batch.max_tokens_per_batch and --batch.fairness_window. We can patch via /admin/config on the runtime pool to change without full deploy. Recommend: set max_tokens_per_batch=48 (was 512), fairness_window=200ms, and kv_cache_lru_threshold=0.8 (was 0.6).
Ana (oncall): Can you post the exact curl? I'll run it on prod-eu pool.
Li (runtime): curl -sS -X POST https://admin.prod-eu.internal/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"batch.max_tokens_per_batch":48,"batch.fairness_window_ms":200,"kv_cache.lru_threshold":0.8}'
Ana (oncall): running now... 
deploy-bot: Triggered config patch job config-patch-1775501010 on pool prod-eu (user=Ana)
Ana (oncall): PATCH applied to 5/6 nodes; awaiting convergence
Ana (oncall): immediate metrics: 5m 99p latency dropped from 8.4s -> 420ms; error rate down from 12% -> 3.1% in first 30s.
Raj CS: customers still see some errors but much improved. Opening tickets correlating to request ids.
Kevin SRE: next step: partial canary for scheduler change: add short-request priority class and enable dynamic preemption for 5% of traffic. Li, can you prepare patch for the scheduler prioritizer? We should avoid full rollout until next maintenance window but canary is ok.
Li (runtime): prepping PR now: prioritizer uses token_count estimate < 64 => high priority. Will target canary label \"prio-canary-1\".
deploy-bot: Started canary rollout prio-canary-1 to 2 nodes
Ana (oncall): Observing tail for long reqs: latency for long completes still high but short reqs stable. Dashboard: request distribution shows fewer long tail spikes after canary.
Kevin SRE: Ops note: added temporary autoscaling spike to handle backlog: scaled Dedicated pool by +30% capacity for 20m. This should reduce queuing
Maria PM: Customer impact summary for status page? Short bullet please.
Ana (oncall): Draft for status page: \"Partial service degradation affecting completion jobs in prod-eu-west from 13:02-13:35 UTC. Root cause: KV cache eviction storm + batch scheduler fairness regression after model rollout. Mitigation: runtime batch and kv-cache config patch, and canary scheduler prioritization. Errors reduced from 12% -> <1% by 13:30. Some customers may have experienced timeouts; CS notified.\"
Li (runtime): PR merged to canary branch; telemetry shows 99p for short reqs ~180ms; long reqs 95p ~2.1s (improved from 8s). Error rate now 0.6% across pool.
Ana (oncall): Handoff: I'm stepping off in 30m. Kevin, you're primary for follow-up (investigate model rollout gating and add automatic batch-profile detection). Key action items in thread.
Kevin SRE: Taking. I'll run deeper root cause and propose a permanent scheduler fix + model rollout checklist
Raj CS: I'll continue to collect customer logs and update tickets. Ping me for any follow-ups for impacted tenants.
ops-runbook-bot: Note added to incident runbook: incident_id=inc-1775501010, mitigation actions: config-patch, canary-prioritizer, autoscale topo. Oncall handover at 13:45 UTC.
Ana (oncall): Closing immediate page. Moving to monitoring mode. Final note: good cross-team response. We'll prepare postmortem and include targeted alarms for kvcache eviction rate and batcher backlog.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned to Kevin SRE for P1 follow-up. Incident closed to paging at 13:35 UTC. Final metrics snapshot: peak 99p 8.4s -> 0.42s after patch; total 5m error seconds avoided ~1200s.
Kevin SRE: I'll open the postmortem doc and link here when ready.
Ana (oncall): Thanks all :thumbsup:
